transcript.answer: Otto's `EscalationTrigger` type has 10 members, going by FR-002 of the support-agent-escalation spec. They are: `tms_unavailable`, `tms_timeout`, `no_tool_for_question`, `customer_asked_for_human`, `out_of_scope_change_request`, `tool_budget_exhausted`, `model_call_failed`, `blocked_consequential_call`, `tool_crashed` and `customer_scope_conflict`. The FR-002 excerpt I read was cut off after the sentence about which triggers are deterministic. The list reads as complete, but a later addition in the truncated part is possible. The spec also describes the set as growing, since each new member has to be added to the exhaustive-switch fixture.
